fact: The Centre d'innovation technologique de N'Djamena, created by arrete n0050 of 1 September 2025, was officially launched with an aim to incubate Chadian tech startups, with no incubation programme or cohort stated.
The startup day was held at WenakLabs in N'Djamena with Tcharay HUB, both named as hubs with founders speaking; no programme or cohort is stated.
Russell Southwood says Chad Innovation Hub lists seven organisations in its incubator spaces, with no cohort programme described.
Le N'Djam Post reports the University of N'Djamena launched its first university incubator on the Toukra campus and opened a call for its first cohort of 25 founders on 22 August 2025.
We Are Tech reports Chad Innovation Hub, a youth entrepreneurship incubator, signed an MoU with ANIE announced 23 January 2024; no programme or cohort is described.
ONAPE's PROJIACE retained 25 projects from over 600 applications on 15 May 2026, 8 for an acceleration track and 17 for incubation.
